ai_review.summary: Phenomenal Owsley audience tape of a smoking Dark Star > Stomp > Morning Dew with excellent room sound and high‑energy performance
ai_review.review: The recording captures an outstanding 1972 segment featuring a searing Dark Star that flows into Phil’s angular bass “stomp” and culminates in a breathtaking Morning Dew.  Owsley’s experimental mic placement delivers crystal‑clear audience ambience, making this one of the best AUD sources despite a small unpatched cut in the Dark Star.  Reviewers overwhelmingly praise both the performance and the tape quality.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high ratings (mostly 5‑star) highlight a superb performance and an exceptional audience recording; only minor technical blemish noted.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Owsley's mic placement yields vivid room sound and great clarity; reviewers call it phenomenal.  One note mentions an unpatched cut in the Dark Star segment, but no major drop‑outs or muffiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A tight 45‑minute suite that builds from an angular bass intro into a deep, flowing jam and ends with an emotional Morning Dew; transitions praised for their musical logic.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar work on Dark Star described as “meltdown” that melts faces; overall performance lauded.
band_member_comments.Phil: His bass “stomp” is highlighted as a standout, with an angular riff that drives the jam.
